tests.__description__: Tests for minecraft:behavior.* components, AI goals, and entity targeting

tests.name: wolf_hunts_creepers
tests.description: Wolf that specifically targets and attacks creepers using filtered nearest_attackable_target
tests.prompt: Create a wolf variant that hunts and attacks creepers. It should ignore other mobs and players.

tests.name: breedable_farm_animal
tests.description: Farm animal that can breed with wheat and produces offspring
tests.prompt: Make this mob breedable. It should be attracted to wheat and produce a baby when two adults breed.

tests.name: guard_patrol_ai
tests.description: Guard mob with patrol behavior and territory defense
tests.prompt: Create a guard that patrols between points and attacks any hostile mobs that enter its territory.

tests.name: simple_passive_mob
tests.description: Basic passive mob with random stroll and look behaviors
tests.prompt: Add basic passive AI to this mob. It should wander around randomly and look at nearby players.

tests.name: panic_on_hurt
tests.description: Mob that panics and runs away when damaged
tests.prompt: Make this mob panic and run away quickly when it takes damage. It should run 50% faster than normal while panicking.

tests.name: tameable_pet
tests.description: Mob that can be tamed by a player and follows them
tests.prompt: Make this mob tameable with bones. Once tamed, it should follow its owner and sit on command.

tests.name: skeleton_archer
tests.description: Ranged mob that shoots arrows at players and avoids melee range
tests.prompt: Create a skeleton-style archer that shoots arrows at players from a distance. It should try to maintain distance and avoid getting close.

tests.name: creeper_exploder
tests.description: Creeper-style mob with swell and explode behavior (tests component dependencies)
tests.prompt: Create a creeper-like mob that swells up and explodes when near a player. Explosion power should be 3.

tests.name: rideable_mount
tests.description: Mob that can be ridden by a player with ground controls (tests rideable + input_ground_controlled)
tests.prompt: Make this mob rideable by a player. The player should be able to control its movement with WASD. Set the seat offset to 1.5 blocks above the ground.

tests.name: multi_behavior_boss
tests.description: Boss mob with multiple attack types, knockback resistance, and high HP
tests.prompt: Create a boss mob with 100 HP, melee attack dealing 8 damage, knockback resistance of 0.5, and it should target players within 32 blocks.

tests.__description__: Tests for minecraft:item components. LLMs must NOT add entity-only components like health or AI.

tests.name: diamond_greatsword
tests.description: Custom sword with high damage and durability
tests.prompt: Create a diamond greatsword item with 12 base damage and 500 durability.

tests.name: explosive_crossbow
tests.description: Crossbow that fires explosive projectiles
tests.prompt: Create a crossbow that shoots explosive arrows. It should have 300 durability.

tests.name: fortune_pickaxe
tests.description: Pickaxe with mining speed modifiers and destroy_speeds array
tests.prompt: Create an enchanted pickaxe that mines stone-type blocks 2x faster than normal. It should have 1000 durability.

tests.name: simple_stick_weapon
tests.description: Basic weapon with just damage, no durability
tests.prompt: Create a simple wooden club item that deals 4 damage.

tests.name: food_item
tests.description: Consumable food item with nutrition and saturation
tests.prompt: Create a cooked steak food item that restores 8 hunger points and has a saturation modifier of 0.8.

tests.name: throwable_item
tests.description: Throwable projectile item like a snowball or ender pearl
tests.prompt: Create a throwable bomb item. It should use the projectile component and have 16 max stack size.

tests.name: armor_chestplate
tests.description: Armor item with protection value and durability
tests.prompt: Create a diamond chestplate with 8 armor protection and 400 durability. It should be wearable.

tests.name: cooldown_ability_item
tests.description: Item with cooldown and use_duration for ability-style usage
tests.prompt: Create a magic wand item with 5 damage, 200 durability, and a 3-second cooldown between uses. The cooldown category should be 'magic_wand'.

tests.name: multi_component_tool
tests.description: Tool with digger, damage, durability, and repair components
tests.prompt: Create a multi-tool that deals 6 damage, has 800 durability, mines wood-type blocks faster, and can be repaired with iron ingots.

tests.name: shield_item
tests.description: Basic shield item with durability and wearable
tests.prompt: Create a wooden shield item with 250 durability. It should be wearable in the offhand.

tests.__description__: Tests for custom block geometry. origin/size must be [x,y,z] arrays.

tests.name: wooden_chair
tests.description: Chair block with custom geometry and collision box
tests.prompt: Create a wooden chair block with a seat height of 8 pixels. Use custom geometry.

tests.name: glowing_lamp
tests.description: Lamp block that emits light level 15 with selection box
tests.prompt: Create a decorative lamp block that emits maximum light (level 15) and has a small selection box.

tests.name: glass_table
tests.description: Transparent table with alpha_test material and collision/selection boxes
tests.prompt: Create a glass table block. It should be transparent and have a collision box only for the top surface.

tests.name: simple_slab
tests.description: Basic half-slab block with geometry and collision box
tests.prompt: Create a stone slab block that is half the height of a normal block. Use custom geometry.

tests.name: basic_decorative_block
tests.description: Simple decorative block with just geometry
tests.prompt: Create a decorative pillar block using custom geometry.

tests.name: light_dimmer_block
tests.description: Block with specific light emission level
tests.prompt: Create a dim torch block that emits light level 7.

tests.name: destructible_block
tests.description: Block with specific destroy time and explosion resistance
tests.prompt: Create a reinforced crate block with custom geometry. It should take 5 seconds to mine and have an explosion resistance of 10.

tests.name: rotatable_furniture
tests.description: Block with rotation trait and custom geometry
tests.prompt: Create a bookshelf block with custom geometry that can be rotated in 4 directions when placed.

tests.name: crafting_station_block
tests.description: Block with crafting table functionality, geometry, and material instances
tests.prompt: Create a custom crafting station block with custom geometry, a unique texture via material_instances, collision and selection boxes, and a crafting_table component.

tests.name: multi_face_textured_block
tests.description: Block with different textures on different faces via material_instances
tests.prompt: Create a display case block with custom geometry. The top face should use a glass texture with alpha_test rendering, and all other faces should use a wood texture with opaque rendering.

tests.__description__: Tests for loot pool structure and shaped/shapeless recipes.

tests.name: shaped_sword_recipe
tests.description: 3x3 shaped recipe where 'key' is an Object with character keys
tests.prompt: Create a shaped crafting recipe for a diamond sword: 1 diamond on top, 1 diamond in middle, 1 stick at bottom (vertical pattern).

tests.name: zombie_loot_table
tests.description: Loot table with multiple pools, rolls, and weighted entries
tests.prompt: Create a loot table for a zombie. It should always drop 0-2 rotten flesh, and have a 10% chance to drop an iron ingot.

tests.name: nested_treasure_loot
tests.description: Complex loot table with conditions, functions, and weighted entries
tests.prompt: Create a treasure chest loot table with: 1) A pool that gives 2-4 gold ingots, 2) A pool with 50% chance for diamond OR emerald (weighted 1:2), 3) Apply 'set_count' function.

tests.name: simple_single_drop
tests.description: Simplest possible loot table with one pool and one entry
tests.prompt: Create a loot table that always drops exactly 1 apple.

tests.name: simple_shapeless_recipe
tests.description: Shapeless recipe with ingredients array
tests.prompt: Create a shapeless recipe that combines 1 red dye and 1 yellow dye to produce 2 orange dye.

tests.name: furnace_recipe
tests.description: Furnace/smelting recipe
tests.prompt: Create a furnace recipe that smelts custom:raw_silver into custom:silver_ingot.

tests.name: weighted_mob_loot
tests.description: Loot table with weighted entries in a single pool
tests.prompt: Create a loot table for a skeleton. It should drop either bones (weight 3) or arrows (weight 2) from a single pool with 1-3 rolls.

tests.name: shaped_armor_recipe
tests.description: Shaped recipe for armor with 3x3 pattern
tests.prompt: Create a shaped crafting recipe for an iron chestplate. The pattern should use 'I' for iron ingots arranged in the standard chestplate pattern.

tests.name: enchanted_loot_functions
tests.description: Loot table using enchant_randomly and set_count functions
tests.prompt: Create a dungeon chest loot table with: 1) A pool giving 1-3 iron swords with random enchantments, 2) A pool giving 4-8 arrows, 3) A pool with 25% chance for a diamond.

tests.name: conditional_player_kill_loot
tests.description: Loot table with killed_by_player condition
tests.prompt: Create a loot table for a wither skeleton. It should always drop 0-2 bones, and only drop a wither skeleton skull (2.5% chance) if killed by a player.

tests.__description__: Tests for manifest.json structure. Validate UUID v4 format and 'type': 'script' in modules.

tests.name: script_manifest_basic
tests.description: Manifest with valid UUID v4 and script module type
tests.prompt: Create a manifest.json for a behavior pack with scripting enabled. Include @minecraft/server as a dependency.

tests.name: custom_component_def
tests.description: Script module with entry point and valid UUID v4
tests.prompt: Create a manifest for a custom component pack. The script entry point should be 'scripts/main.js'.

tests.name: gametest_module
tests.description: GameTest framework manifest with proper dependencies and UUID validation
tests.prompt: Create a manifest for a GameTest behavior pack. Include both @minecraft/server and @minecraft/server-gametest dependencies.

tests.name: simple_data_module
tests.description: Basic manifest with data module (not script)
tests.prompt: Create a basic manifest.json for a behavior pack with a single data module. No scripting needed.

tests.name: resource_pack_manifest
tests.description: Resource pack manifest with resources module
tests.prompt: Create a manifest.json for a resource pack. The module type should be 'resources'.

tests.name: versioned_manifest
tests.description: Manifest with specific version numbers
tests.prompt: Create a manifest.json for a behavior pack version 2.1.0 with min engine version 1.21.50. Include a data module.

tests.name: script_with_ui
tests.description: Script manifest with server-ui dependency
tests.prompt: Create a manifest for a script pack that uses the server UI API. Include @minecraft/server and @minecraft/server-ui as dependencies. Entry point is 'scripts/ui_handler.js'.

tests.name: multi_module_manifest
tests.description: Manifest with both script and data modules
tests.prompt: Create a manifest with two modules: a 'data' module and a 'script' module with entry 'scripts/main.js'. Include @minecraft/server dependency.

tests.name: full_addon_manifest
tests.description: Complete addon manifest with script module, multiple dependencies, and metadata
tests.prompt: Create a complete manifest for an addon with scripting. Include @minecraft/server (1.12.0), @minecraft/server-ui (1.2.0), and @minecraft/server-gametest (1.0.0) as dependencies. Script entry is 'scripts/addon.js'. Add metadata with 'authors' array containing 'TestAuthor'.

tests.name: world_template_manifest
tests.description: World template manifest with world_template module type
tests.prompt: Create a manifest.json for a world template. The module type should be 'world_template'. Include a lock_template_options field set to true in the header.
